what: Step speed: a device-agnostic movement variable
title: Data Overview and Per-Species Sampling
text: running spatial autocorrelation analysis, recompute speed great-circle displacement divided time interval, rather using tracker’s speed field. Tracker-reported speed varies devices (Doppler, displacement averages, proprietary smoothing) many low-cost trackers report speed . Computing raw fix coordinates yields reproducible, device-agnostic variable. compute_step_speed() defaults centered mode: fix’s step speed total displacement two adjacent fixes divided total time, capturing take-landing events symmetrically producing edge NAs. title: Movement-State Segmentation with BALM
text: balm_segmentation() classifies tracking fix movement state using BALM (Behaviorally-Anchored Local Moran), movement-adapted variant Local Moran scatterplot. uses point locations movement-rate mark – never direction raw temporal sequence – invariant fix ordering robust sampling-rate heterogeneity. fix labelled signs deviation behavioral reference c (migratory-flight onset) spatial lag: HH – fast fix among fast neighbours -> active migration LL – slow fix among slow neighbours -> stationary site HL – fast fix among slow neighbours -> local movement within site (commuting / foraging burst) LH – slow fix among fast neighbours -> brief touch-migratory corridor (transient stopover) Two choices distinguish BALM textbook Local Moran: high/low reference data-driven behavioral threshold (flight-onset speed) rather arithmetic mean, classification deterministic (permutation significance) – spatial support arbitrated downstream density clustering (dbscan_habitats()).

title: DBSCAN Temporary Habitat Delineation
text: dbscan_habitats() clusters low-speed points (LL stationary cores plus LH short-stopover arrivals) balm_segmentation() spatially-bounded temporary habitats, using standard DBSCAN (Ester et al. 1996) per individual. two parameters derived data detect_habitat_params(), hard-coded, explicit behavioural meaning: eps – within-site movement radius. segmented track, consecutive steps whose endpoints stationary (BALM “LL”) genuine within-site moves; pooled across individuals fit log-Gaussian mixture, split largest mean-gap within-site complex higher relocation modes. eps 95th percentile within-site complex. minPts – minimum-residence floor: knee aggregate habitat-count vs minPts curve eps. meaning temporal – minPts x sampling-interval = minimum residence duration (reported), set directly min_residence (days). detect_habitat_params() also reports regime (“migratory” flight (HH) steps exist, else “continuous”) gap_ratio, fold-separation flight within-site scales.

HH (flight) steps represent migratory state — large- scale relocations wintering breeding ranges — belong macro scale, habitat delineation, excluded . LL fixes single behaviour. bird wintering breeding grounds, LL–LL steps mix two states: within-habitat activity (resting, foraging, short local transits — small spatial scale) -habitat transfer (moves one temporary habitat another — larger scale). Pooled across individuals fit log-Gaussian mixture, split largest mean-gap; eps 95th percentile lower, within-habitat complex — exactly radius separates within-habitat activity -habitat transfer. figure overlays fitted log-Gaussian mixture (refit set.seed(1) / mclust::Mclust(G = 1:5) call function uses) empirical LL–LL distribution. dark-blue curve within-habitat component(s); eps 95th percentile, marked dashed line.

s <- s[order(s$time), ]   st <- as.character(s$cluster_type); d <- gx(st_coordinates(s))   if (!length(d)) return(numeric(0))   keep <- st[-length(st)] == "LL" & st[-1] == "LL"   # both endpoints stationary   d[keep & d > 0] }))  # Empirical LL–LL density (natural-log scale, matching the eps derivation), # split at eps: within-habitat (<= eps) vs between-habitat (> eps) lv <- log(ll_steps) dn <- stats::density(lv) xb <- log(p$eps); yb <- stats::approx(dn$x, dn$y, xout = xb)$y dd <- rbind(   data.frame(x = c(dn$x[dn$x <= xb], xb), y = c(dn$y[dn$x <= xb], yb),              region = "within-habitat activity"),   data.frame(x = c(xb, dn$x[dn$x > xb]), y = c(yb, dn$y[dn$x > xb]),              region = "between-habitat transfer")) dd$region <- factor(dd$region,                     levels = c("within-habitat activity", "between-habitat transfer"))  # Refit the same GMM used to derive eps, and split at the largest mean-gap mclustBIC <- mclust::mclustBIC          # mclust requires this in scope set.seed(1L) fit <- mclust::Mclust(sort(lv), G = 1:5, verbose = FALSE) mu  <- fit$parameters$mean v   <- fit$parameters$variance$sigmasq; if (length(v) == 1L) v <- rep(v, fit$G) w   <- fit$parameters$pro om  <- order(mu); mu <- mu[om]; v <- v[om]; w <- w[om] cut <- if (fit$G > 1L) which.max(diff(mu)) else 1L loc <- seq_len(cut); rel <- if (cut < fit$G) (cut + 1L):fit$G else integer(0) mix <- function(idx) if (!length(idx)) rep(0, length(dn$x)) else   Reduce(`+`, lapply(idx, function(i) w[i] * stats::dnorm(dn$x, mu[i], sqrt(v[i])))) gmm <- rbind(   data.frame(x = dn$x, dens = mix(loc), component = "within-habitat Gaussian"),   data.frame(x = dn$x, dens = mix(rel), component = "between-habitat Gaussian")) gmm <- gmm[!(gmm$component == "between-habitat Gaussian" & !length(rel)), ] gmm$component <- factor(gmm$component,                         levels = c("within-habitat Gaussian", "between-habitat Gaussian"))  ggplot() +   geom_area(data = dd, aes(x, y, fill = region), alpha = 0.35) +   geom_line(data = gmm, aes(x, dens, colour = component), linewidth = 0.9) +   geom_vline(xintercept = xb, colour = "#E01B1B", linetype = "dashed") +   annotate("text", x = xb, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.6, size = 3.4,            colour = "#E01B1B", label = sprintf("eps = %.2f km", p$eps)) +   scale_x_continuous(labels = function(v) signif(exp(v), 2)) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c("within-habitat activity"  = "#2C7BB6",                                "between-habitat transfer" = "#FDAE61")) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c("within-habitat Gaussian"  = "#1A4E7A",                                  "between-habitat Gaussian" = "#B5651D")) +   labs(x = "LL–LL step distance (km, log scale)", y = "density",        fill = NULL, colour = NULL,        title = "LL steps split by eps: within- vs between-habitat moves") +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "top")

title: Inter-Annual Site Fidelity (ISFI)
text: compute_isfi() quantifies often individual returns temporary habitat (nest) across years: ISFI=∑ini,years−n(c−1)⋅n \text{ISFI} = \frac{\sum_i n_{,\text{years}} - n}{(c - 1) \cdot n} n unique clusters, c unique years, n_{,years} number years cluster visited. ISFI ranges 0 (fidelity) 1 (every cluster revisited every year). single overall ISFI averaged across entire annual cycle biologically uninformative: bird may highly faithful wintering grounds choose different stopover sites year. recommended workflow therefore stratify ISFI life- history phase, exposing cycle fidelity strongest.

title: Behaviorally-Anchored Local Moran (BALM) movement-state segmentation — balm_segmentation
text: BALM adapts Moran scatterplot (value vs spatial lag) two ways suited movement data: Behavioral anchoring. high/low reference arithmetic mean (standard Local Moran centering) data-driven behavioral threshold c: onset flight mode. estimated pooled (log) movement-rate individuals Gaussian-mixture decomposition (component count chosen BIC); c lower 5\ yields stable species-level threshold, applied every individual, spatial neighbourhood stays per individual. Deterministic classification. fix labelled signs deviation d_i = x_i - c spatial lag Sum_j w_ij d_j; permutation significance applied. Spatial support arbitrated downstream density clustering (dbscan_habitats()). four states follow Moran-scatterplot quadrants: HH: fast fix among fast neighbours -> migration. LL: slow fix among slow neighbours -> stationary site. HL: fast fix among slow neighbours -> local movement within site (e.g. commuting foraging burst). LH: slow fix among fast neighbours -> brief touch-migratory corridor (transient stopover). never uses direction fix ordering, BALM invariant temporal sequence robust sampling-rate heterogeneity.

title: Compute Individual Site Fidelity Index (ISFI) — compute_isfi
text: Quantifies inter-annual site fidelity per individual: probability given temporary habitat (cluster) revisited across multiple years. Defined $$\mathrm{ISFI} = \frac{\left(\sum_i n_{,\mathrm{years}}\right) - n}{(c - 1) \cdot n}$$ \(n\) number unique clusters, \(c\) number unique years, \(n_{,\mathrm{years}}\) count distinct years cluster \(\) visited.
